newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: Slovak c.bank allots SKK2.5bln in repos, 16.04 pct.
newsitem.headline: Slovak c.bank allots SKK2.5bln in repos, 16.04 pct.

text.p: The National Bank of Slovakia (NBS) on Tuesday said it had allocated funds totalling 2.5 billion crowns at this morning's securities repurchase tender at an average rate of 16.04 percent.
At the NBS's overnight repurchase tender on Monday, the average rate was 16.13 percent, up from 10.53 percent in the previous repo tender with a similar maturity.
The NBS added that the total volume of all bids submitted for the tender was 3.74 billion crowns.
The NBS said in a statement the maximum bid rate in the tender hit 19.0 percent, while the minimum rate had been fixed at 9.7 percent, though banks' minimum bids were at 15.84 percent.
The NBS holds tenders on a daily basis if needed, instead of quoting securities repo and reverse repo rates.
